name: Tree turns to rocks
description: People fell giant tree. The fallen tree and/or its stump turns into mountain(s) or rocks

name: Sounds of the time of creation: a creaking of trees
description: Man pushes his mother-in-law or his wife into a tree hollow, she turns into the creaking of trees or into echo

name: Waves turn into mountains
description: Waves of the sea petrified and turned into dry land with mountain chains

name: Fungi and excrescences (ogress transformed)
description: A female demonic person, usually while she is pursuing a man, dies and her flesh turns into objects that are found on trees, like fungi, pitch, fruits or nuts

name: Woman turns into a tree, penis captured
description: Man copulates with a woman who turns into tree or rock, his penis is captured in it

name: Tree fruits for a woman
description: Baby child or children who come out of mother's womb and turn themselves into adult men or a snake who lives in her womb climb up a tree and help the woman to gather fruits, bark, edible fungi, etc. Usually the child who is a snake returns to his mother's womb and adult man turns back into a baby; or the girl's love affair with a snake is discovered when her father climbs a tree to gather fruits for her

name: Tree is a person
description: A giant tree (often with water inside it or with different cultivated plants on its branches) grows out of the human body or is transformed person

name: Brother abandoned in a tree
description: A girl becomes separated with her brothers (or brother) who die, remain in a tree, on a hill, ascend to the sky, etc. After being happily married, the girl once again meets her brothers who have acquired a non-human nature

name: Transformed into tree-frog
description: Person who sucks honey greedily from a tree hollow and/or is stuck in it turns into tree-frog

name: Transformed into stone
description: God agrees or suggests to fulfill a demand of a man. As a result the latter is transformed into a stone
